caption: The AI agent's answer to our Dutch question about whether we test software ourselves: some reviews are tested hands-on and dated, others are based on supplier information. One observed answer, not an accuracy benchmark.
Our English question to the AI agent was refused with 'Ik spreek uw taal niet' (I do not speak your language) in this Dutch-language account, followed by an offer of a human agent.
The admin copilot's summary after approval: group Billing created, and a trigger that assigns new tickets whose subject contains factuur or invoice to Billing.
The first trigger attempt: the admin copilot reports that the field subject is not valid in trigger conditions and proposes title; the trigger only succeeded on the third approval.
Plan comparison on annual billing: Support Team €19, Suite Team €55 and Suite Professional €115 per agent a month; Copilot is a €50 add-on on Professional, the plan the trial runs on.
Accelerated setup on the trial (12 days left): the website address came prefilled, with no card, phone number or mailbox connection asked for.
Synthetic Ticket #3 'Vraag over mijn factuur van oktober', saved as an internal note, shows Billing in the assignee field; the author's name is hidden.
